name: ClearSmile Dental Clinic

summary_en: ClearSmile Dental Clinic, located in Bangkok, is a specialized dental practice that holds a perfect 5-star rating based on 5 total reviews. The clinic maintains a trust score of 58.4 and focuses on providing professional dental care services within the city.
